Data compaction can reduce the number the frames transferred over the network. The contribution of the following work is to estimating the number of Frames/Packets need to store block of data and calculating the bandwidth of the network due to stacked based network architecture.

articleTitle: Graph Energy Based Centrality Measure to Identify Influential Nodes in Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: One of the measures to analyze complex network is vertex centrality; it can reveal existing network patterns. It helps us in understanding networks. One of the measures to analyze complex network is vertex centrality, and it can reveal existing network patterns. It helps us in understanding networks and their components by analyzing their structural properties. The social network is one of the complex networks which is composed of nodes and relationships. It is growing very vastly due to the addition of new nodes every day. All nodes are not equally important in such a vast network hence, identifying influential nodes becomes a practical problem. Centrality measures were introduced to quantify the importance of nodes in networks. The various criterion is used to select critical nodes in the network. Therefore, different centrality measures like Betweenness Centrality, Degree Centrality, Closeness Centrality, and other well-known centrality measures are used to identify essential nodes. We have proposed an algorithm to compute a centrality using graph energy called Energy-Based-Centrality-Measure (EBCM) in this paper. It identifies the central nodes based on a graph invariant called graph energy. EBCM gives a better understanding of the current network by analyzing the impact of node deletion on graph connectivity and thereby helps us in achieving a better network understanding ability and maintenance.

articleTitle: Optimize power using reconfiguration strategy for dynamic inhomogeneous illumination for SPV array with Stochastic Noise Suppression
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Energy conversion of solar panel array is significantly affected by partial or complete shading, especially when the panel is exposed in the dynamic inhomogeneous illumination environment. This generated power not only depend on the light intensity falling on it but depends on the series-parallel connection of solar panels too. Natural light intensity is variable, depending on various environmental condition, power output is obtained which might or might not be as per desirability because of non-uniform illumination (NUI). To complete, the prospects, series-parallel connections of panels can be reconfigured with the help of sensor as per NUI pattern on the array which could generate desired output power based on same environmental conditions. Due to degradation, aging, and exposure, the performance of the sensor decreases, leading to weakening in proper functionality, an increase in the possible faults and failures. This may as well contribute to the occurrence of stochastic noise. However, these sensors still generate noise, just as any other dynamic system creating stochastic noise. Without imposing any special requirement for sensing equipment, the method introduced here employs the aspect that sensor evaluations portray the dynamic characteristics of the measured data. Thus, an adaptive bank of graded filters (ABoGF) algorithm is used to detect, estimate and suppress the sensor stochastic noise characteristic, which allows recognition of sensor stochastic noise, necessary to maintain sensors stability and performance.

articleTitle: Cost Optimized Navigation System for Multimodal Routes
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Transport being an integral part of day to day travel inspires the introduction of effectual and smarter ways of commuting. Multi-modal transport services with customer- centric designs is a demanding concern. The proposed system aims at the development of multi-modal transport options with the emphasis on cost-optimized routing techniques. In this paper, we propose a cost-optimized transit-transportation scheme for Mumbai where the ideal cost-efficient route is computed through the combination of travel by train, bus and auto rickshaw. Also, the users are enabled to add various share a rickshaw spots in Mumbai through a community driven environment which would raise the quality of result provided to the user.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Prioritized Bandwidth Management in 802.11e WLAN
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Providing reliable bandwidth for end users anywhere and anytime is the critical goal for the wireless community. There are lots of bandwidth management scheme available for wireless network. For bandwidth management in 802.11 wireless LAN, EDCA (enhanced distributed channel access) provides service differentiation by providing different priority for different traffic category. There is no any specific bandwidth management scheme based on user type or user category. Most of the bandwidth management scheme treats all the users with equal priority. In this paper, we have proposed a bandwidth management scheme for IEEE 802.11 wireless LAN which is based on user priority. For this we have considered three types of users: high priority, medium priority and low priority. The proposed bandwidth management scheme allocates the available bandwidth to high priority users first irrespective of the traffic type, then to medium priority users and low priority users are entertained at last based on the availability of the bandwidth resources. For evaluating the performance of the proposed method, five parameters are taken. These are traffic received, traffic sent, data dropped, delay and throughput. From the comparative analysis, we have observed that the proposed algorithm can give fair bandwidth allocation to the higher priority user on demand. From the simulation results it is also seen that the high priority users achieve good quality of service in every aspect compared to medium and lower priority users.

articleTitle: A Fast Approach for Video Deblurring using Multi-Scale Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In many computer vision tasks, the non-uniform blind deblurring is a serious issue. Camera shake, multiple object motions and scene depth variation are some of the major causes of motion blur which need to be tackled carefully. Video deblurring is an algorithmic approach which takes multiple corrupt, blurred and mis-focused images and estimates the clean images. In the literature, video based methodologies leverage the information available across neighbouring frames to deblur the images, which is in contrast to single image deblurring techniques. This is the reason that the performance of the video deblurring techniques depends on alignment of neighbouring frames. However, aligning neighbouring frames is a expensive task in terms of computation and it requires high level scene understanding so that one can clearly distinguish between regions that have been precisely aligned from those that have been not. Also, it is an important that any video deblurring methods should have minimum latency in real time. In this work, we gradually restore sharp video frame from a blurred one in a `course-to-fine' manner. We use a multi-scale deep learning based model for deblurring an image in an end-to-end manner. The experimental evaluation shows that the proposed technique performs faster when compared to other video deblurring technique with substantial improvement in qualitative and quantitative performance.

articleTitle: Word Segmentation in Document Images using Deep Convolutional Encoder Decoder Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Tremendous amount of data is present in the form of scanned document ScD or in digital image format. To extract information present in documents Optical Character Recognition OCR of these documents is unavoidable. OCR software [2], [3] internally segments pieces of word and OCR that specific parts. So to the great extent accuracy of OCR and quality of text recognition is reliant on the quality of segmentation achieved. In this study, we propose a novel technique for Word Level Segmentation WLS using Deep Learning DL. To handle unavailability of annotated data artificial data generation technique is also proposed.

articleTitle: Feature-based Land Use/ Land Cover Classification of Google Earth Imagery
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this paper, we presented a novel method to classify land use/land cover objects of earth surface using google earth imagery. The Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) is used to extract second order statistical features. Opening, closing, and reconstruction operators are used to extract morphological features of objects. The extracted texture features and morphological features are fused to improve the classification accuracy. The spectral reflectance of the endmember classes is calculated using Linear Spectral Mixture Model (LSMM). Multiple thresholds are generated for each class. The generated spectral properties and thresholding are used to classify features set. The classification accuracy of the resulted thematic map of the specified geographical area is compared with the generic KNN method.

articleTitle: Bandwidth Enhanced UHF- Discone Antenna for FOPEN Radar
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper elaborates on the development of Ultra High Frequency (UHF) band Discone for FOliage PENetrating (FOPEN) Radar application. FOPEN systems suffer from low bandwidth antenna. In this paper an attempt has been made to improve the bandwidth of the antenna. Slots has been created on the aperture of the antenna creating virtual impedance to improve the current distribution and thus improving the bandwidth. The developed antenna has been loaded with Split Ring Resonator (SRR) to improve the bandwidth performance further. Simulation results depict the bandwidth enhancement of discone using slot extraction technique and metamaterial antenna load by 8%. Antenna sighting studies has been carried out by mounting the antenna on a Grumman C-1 aircraft. The antenna radiation scattering as well as the change in reflection coefficient performance has been expound.

articleTitle: Ultra-wide-band Flexible Antenna for Breast Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this flexible antenna, It is a versatile antenna design for a non-invasive and susceptible methodology to sight breast cancer in the early stages, so that the probability of dying due to breast cancer can be decreased in women. Exploitation thin film Rogers RT/duraid 5880(tm) substrate the versatile antenna has been engineered and applied by the utilization of AnsysHFSS16.2 software package. The planned structure operate on the basis of an UWB characteristic providing aver essential bandwidth of concerning 3.5GHz to 14 GHz with a middle frequency around 8GHz. An antenna designed with model of multi-layer for the ladies breast . This flexible antenna results point out that the planned antenna unbroken it Ultra-wide-band property. The general size of the Ultra-wide-band Flexible Antenna is 16mm×16mm that build it nearly this Ultra-wideband Flexible Antenna Appropriate for women Breast cancer detection.

articleTitle: Comparison of Different Pan Sharpening Techniques using Landsat 8 Imagery
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Pan sharpening technique is a widely used image processing technique which combines the data available from various sensors and exploits its varied capabilities. In this study, the efficiency of four diverse pan sharpening methods namely High Pass filter, Modified Intensity Hue Saturation, Ehlers fusion and Hyperspectral Colour Sharpening was evaluated. The pan sharpening approaches are applied to Landsat 8 imagery of an urban area. The spatial and spectral quality of the fused images is assessed using different indices like Bias, RMSE, Correlation Coefficient and ERGAS. The fused images obtained have improved spatial resolution and visual appearance compared to the original MS image. The fused images have a spatial resolution comparable to that of the PAN image. According to visual analysis, Modified IHS method yielded a fused image with better visual interpretability. The statistical analysis shows that the high pass filter is the most suitable pan sharpening method for this dataset. On testing for Bias, RMSE, ERGAS and CC, the high pass filter method performed best followed by Modified Intensity Hue saturation, Ehlers fusion and Hyperspectral Colour Sharpening while Ehlers fusion showed a higher correlation, compared to Modified IHS.

articleTitle: Design of a compact Ultrawideband Printed Elliptical Ring Monopole Antenna for Imaging Radar Application
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: A compact Ultra wideband (UWB) elliptical ring monopole antenna is proposed operating in a frequency band ranging from 1GHz to 3.5GHz with a return loss less than 10dB over this entire frequency band. The antenna is printed on a 1.58 mm thick FR-4 substrate with 100mm×80 mm as substrate dimension and fed by 50 Ω microstrip line. CST Microwave studio has been used to design and simulate the above antenna. The Elliptical ring, Feed gap and Ground plane dimensions has been optimized to achieve stable radiation pattern. It has been seen that the gain is greater than 2dB in the entire operating frequency range with a maximum gain of 4.1 dB at a frequency of 2GHz.

articleTitle: Classification of Faults in a Hybrid Power System using Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Electrical power transmission lines are characterized by very lengthy transmission lines and thus are more exposed to the environment. Consequently, transmission lines are more prone to faults, which hinder the continuity of electric power supplied, increases the loss of electric power generated and loss of economy. Quick detection and classification of a fault hastens its clearance and reduces system downtime thus, improving the security and efficiency of the network. Thus, this paper focuses on developing an artificial neural network to classify the faults in hybrid power system. This work employs a feed-forward artificial neural network with back propagation algorithm for fault classification. The instantaneous voltages and currents values are extracted and used to train the neural network. Simulation results have been provided to demonstrate the efficiency of the developed intelligent system for fault classification in grid-connected hybrid power system. The performance of the classifier is evaluated using the Mean Square Error (MSE).

articleTitle: Texture based Image Species Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Our goal of study, texture based butterfly image classification with considering two standard deep learning networks and their shallower versions. Butterfly images involve only low and mid level texture information, which is typically learnt in the lower and mid-layers of the networks. We explore, whether smaller versions of these networks are robust enough to maintain a reasonable performance, as compared to the complete network, on the butterfly classification task. To identify the homogeneous texture region with texture class it belongs. We also demonstrate the effect of masking the background under the above scenario. Our approach yields high quality best results for the butterfly classification task, and we draw some interesting observations from our experimental analysis.

articleTitle: S-Band Circularly polarized Transceiver Antenna for LEO Satellites
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: A new compact, wideband, circularly polarized (CP) stacked patch antenna is proposed for Telemetry and Telecommand (TT&C) application in nanosatellites. The antenna comprises of a driving patch which is excited by a coaxial feed and a parasitic patch. Circular polarization is achieved by corner truncation and the proposed Single fed S-Band transceiver antenna is fabricated on a Rogers 5880(ε<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub>=2.2) substrate, the antenna is designed and simulated using a HFSSv.14. software. The simulated results shows that the bandwidth of the stacked patch is approximately 300MHz (2.0-2.3GHz) which covers the Telemetry Telecommand band with VSWR less than 2 and a cross polarization of 12dB.

Author Keywords: circularly polarized (CP),Telemetry and Telecommand (TT&C), stacked patch antenna, corner truncation, parasitic patch, cross polarization.

articleTitle: IoT based Design of Intelligent Mirror using Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Internet of things (IoT) is a new way to connect Physical Environment to the Technology, System having wireless connectivity with Internet so that they can communicate with human being and controlled by computer. The Purpose of this paper is to make traditional mirror more Intelligent to make human life smart, safe and luxurious. Proposed Intelligent Mirror identifies its User based on Face reorganization or Speech reorganization and works in two modes: Online mode and Standalone mode. In Standalone mode it works as normal reflecting mirror and in Online mode its gets connected to internet using Raspberry Pi and provides users a relevant information like - today's meetings, hot news, traffic information, remainders, and syllabus etc. Ease of operation, high degree of Human interaction, compact and cost effective are merits of proposed system.

articleTitle: Cross-lingual Information Retrieval: application and Challenges for Indian Languages
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In today's digital era, accessing the web contents in the local regional languages is essential for the developing nations. Cross-Lingual Information Retrieval (CLIR) system add more complexity in terms of average precision as a part of the Indian languages compared to English text documents. CLIR refers to the retrieving data where the query and/or documents are in different languages. The poor performance is due to variation in term and ambiguity in lexical resources. This paper presents the challenges, issues that come along the way when developing CLIR applications which can be used for improving access ratio in local/regional languages and reviews some of the recent research methods in domain of cross lingual retrieval with current innovative directions.

articleTitle: Phase Noise Performance Improvement of X-Band Airborne Radar System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Phase noise performance of microwave synthesizers is sensitive to vibrations to some extent. The reference source is one of the prime performance-limiting components in microwave systems ranging from simple RF receivers to advanced radars. Phase noise performance improvement of PLL during random vibration environment is discussed in this article. It's basically achieved by following methodologies, viz; vibro-isolator compensation technique, purification tactic of source crystal reference for PLL and also analyzed the spatial location for mounting of crystal reference and avoid UUT (unit under test) resonance out of frequency spectrum (PSD) of Random vibration profile. We point out some challenges and provide suggestions for the accurate measurement of vibration sensitivity of Airborne Radar system.

articleTitle: Exudates and Colour Analysis for the Detection of Diabetic Macular Edema
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Diabetic macular edema (DME) is a variation with diabetic retinopathy. Vision loss and blindness are the most common effects of DME. DME is defined as thickening of the retina in diabetic patients due to fluid leakage within macula because of elevated sugar levels over long period. DME is assessed by detecting bright lesions called exudates and swelling of retina in fundus images. In the present paper, an algorithm is developed to detect DME, by estimating the pixel count from macula to nearest hard exudate. The macula and hard exudates are localized using image processing techniques. Severity of estimated from exudates analysis and color analysis. The algorithm is tested with 65 DME images with severity index 0, 1 and 2 from MESSIDOR database.

articleTitle: IR-Based Obstacle Avoiding and Self-Navigating Robot
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This report presents a method for autonomous navigation of a mobile robot, a concept which can be built upon with the goal of achieving long-term robotic activity without human intervention. An IR transmitter is designed consisting of a NE 555 timer (normal remote) and an IR LED, while an IR receiver is mounted to an 8051-microcontroller robot. The system was changed and improved over each iteration, to resist environmental hurdles and implement obstacle avoidance, which ultimately resulted in a navigation success rate of 93 percent over 50 trials.

articleTitle: Design, Analysis and Simulation of Quasi Resonant Passive Snubber for Improving Power Conversion Efficiency of DC-DC Step-Down Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: A quasi resonant passive snubber is designed for input 20≤V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">IN</sub>≤80V, output power of 60W, and switching frequency of 100kHz. Efficiency is measured to be 95.13% by simulation. Proposed snubber consists of six components and during operation zero current turn-on and zero voltage turn-off of the switch are observed. Efficiency is observed to be increased as compared to conventional converter. And this circuit works for both MOSFET and IGBT.

articleTitle: Design of Misalignment Tolerant WPT System for Deep Brain Stimulator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The paper presents the wireless power transfer (WPT) system for Deep Brain Stimulator. In WPT system, low coupling factor (k) and misalignment are the two challenges due to size limitation of implanted coils. In this paper, the design details of two and four coil systems are discussed. To improve k in the system, various coil structures are considered and modelled on dual layer FR4 sheet. The implanted coils are made of nearly 6mmX6mm dimensions for all models. To obtain allowable misalignment range, the proposed models are tested at various lateral displacements. Out of the models presented, hexagonal planar spiral type 4-coil WPT system provides maximum k of 0.029 with misalignment permissible range up to 6 mm. The simulated models are tested at 13.56 MHz using Ansys Electronic Desktop. In addition, experimental results are documented.

articleTitle: Floorplan Based Performance Estimation of Network-on-Chips using Regression Techniques
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: An intra-communication problem between the Intellectual Properties(IPs) caused by the growth of a number of cores on single chips in System-on-Chip(SoC) gave rise to new a system architecture called Network-on-Chip(NoC). The early stages of designing NoC can be done using cycle-accurate NoC simulators, but they become slow as the architecture size of NoC increases. Hence a machine learning framework is being proposed by considering two scenarios i,e. A fixed delay between the components and floorplan based delay among the components of NoC. This framework is modeled using distinct Machine Learning(ML) regression algorithms to predict performance parameters of NoCs considering uniform random and transpose traffic patterns. Complete performance analysis of Mesh NoC architecture can be done by using the proposed ML framework. Booksim simulator results are used to verify effectiveness of proposed framework and it showed an overall speedup of 2000× to 2500×.

articleTitle: Adaptive Channel Estimation & Capacity Analysis for MIMO OFDM Communication in Urban and Sub-urban Environments Using Sparse Diffusion LMS Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Multiple-Input and Multiple-Output (MIMO) has been identified as one of the most effective method used in multicarrier wireless communication. FFT based OFDM (Orthogonal Frequency Division multiplexing) is an attractive multicarrier technique which supports the multiple antenna-based system like MIMO. Estimation of the channel state information (CSI) in the case of MIMO system is a challenging task. The MIMO channel involves a large number of correlated channel coefficients, which has to be estimated correctly in time-varying and non-stationary environments. The main challenge is the practical implementation of the model which deals with high computational complexity. The performance of the communication system improves significantly if the channel state information is available to the receiver. The objective of this paper is efficient tracking of the time-varying correlated coefficients of MIMO channel by using proposed sparse model-based diffusion least mean square (DLMS) algorithm in urban and suburban environments. The experimental investigation is carried out by taking into IEEE802.11, I-METRA & 3GPP spatial channel models. Also, different full rate &full diversity space-time block codes (STBC) have been used to validate the performance of the proposed estimation model with uncertain CSI.

articleTitle: Revolutionary Gaming Style in Motion
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Since 2012 MONECT has been developing the conceptuality for making a remote controller for different types of device controlling where recently in 2017 the including of remote desktop session with gaming control of different games such as racing, Frames Per Seconds (FPS), Role-Playing Game (RPG) and many more where each type of game had its own different type of setup with a familiar layout for those who were used to having different types of controllers for each individual gaming style. Under that development project outcome, the application made full use of the onboard sensors to provide the user with the ultimate experience while playing (Accelerometer, G-Sensor, Gyro etc). Frames Per Second (FPS) mode enabled the gyroscope sensor allowing one to aim at their perspective targets while the Race mode used the G-Sensor to enable steering.

articleTitle: Effect Of Metal Powders On Capacitance And Equivalent Series Resistance Of Super-capacitor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Super-capacitor is an accent to many developing technology for energy storage. Super-capacitors possess the ability to store energy with a higher capacitance value unlike traditional electrolytic capacitors. It also derives other advantages over traditional capacitors in terms of its charging and discharging time. There are many concerns in this field of research in order to increase the efficiency and charge storing ability.Capacitance value is given importance while its internal resistance is overlooked. Reducing internal resistance can increase capabilities of super-capacitors. This paper presents the effect of addition of various proportions of metal powders of different kinds in electrode materials on the equivalent series resistance and capacitance of the super-capacitors. The super-capacitors are constructed by mixing equal proportion of activated carbon and manganese dioxide along with increasing mix of metal powders. Reduction in internal resistance can increase power density. It can eliminate the need of voltage balancing.

articleTitle: Design Validation and Performance Investigation of Signal Conditioning Circuit for Capacitive Sensor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The paper presents the implementation details of an oscillator based signal conditioning circuit for capacitive sensor. The transfer function model of the circuit has been developed. The model of the signal conditioning circuit is validated by calibrating the circuit using precession capacitors. The performance of the circuit is investigated using capacitive RH sensor at standard humidity levels. The standard humidity levels are generated using saturated binary salt solutions prepared as per OIML R121. The measurement uncertainty, accuracy and sensitivity of the system are presented in the paper.

articleTitle: Power Swing and out of step Protection using Equal area Criteria
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Power swing blocking function is used in distance relays to distinguish power swing and fault in power system. But distance relay may mal-operate during power swing condition which can be generated due to variation of heavy load and switching of adjacent loaded line or due to any fault in the system. The new method based on equal area criteria method can successfully identify the power swing and out of step condition in the network. It is independent to change in network configuration. It needs only locally measured quantities like electrical power and power angle. The instability can be observed by monitoring the cumulative acceleration and deceleration area in power angle curve. These areas are continuously computed as well as whether or not the rotor angle reaches the maximum stable rotor angle or not it should be checked. By comparing these areas and from rotor angle, stable and out of step swings condition can be identified.

Author Keywords: power swing and out of step condition

articleTitle: Optimum Scheduling of Residential Appliances along with the Management of Distributed Energy Resources using Mixed Integer Linear Programming
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: With the concept of Smart Grid (SG) becoming a reality, the communication between the SG and the smart meters will enable the residential customers to participate in energy trading. The demand based tariffs and incentives will help in efficient management of the Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) employed in the residences along with the scheduling of the residential loads. The study undertaken classifies the appliances of a single residence into schedulable and real-time loads. It then employs a Residential Energy Management System (REMS) to optimally manage the energy from the DERs along with the operation of the schedulable appliances according to the day-ahead Time of Use (ToU) pricing strategy. For the energy management, three scenarios with significant variations in the solar irradiation, wind speed, outside environment temperature, real-time appliances' schedule and Electric Vehicle's (EV) driving schedule have been considered. An MILP problem has been formulated with the objective of reducing the residential energy expenditure. The results were analyzed to understand the operation of the REMS under different weather and operating dynamics.

articleTitle: The Impact Of Multiple DG Penetration With FCL In Distribution System For The Enhancement Of Protection Coordination Index Using Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: High penetration level of distributed generation (DG) leads to improper protection coordination of the distribution system. In this paper, multiple DG locations are considered to evaluate the protection coordination index value. Due to the penetration of DG causes the change in fault current levels. So to prevent relay maloperation, change in co-ordination of relays is required. Further fault current limiters are used to enhance protection coordination index. Fault currents reduced within the breaking capacity of protective devices when FCL is introduced into the system in the presence of DG penetration. IEEE-14 bus test system is considered in the analysis. A mixed integer PSO Algorithm is used to enhance PCI index and to find optimal FCL size.

articleTitle: Design of New Cascaded Multilevel Inverter Topology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Multilevel Inverter (MLI) has gained a lot of interest in academia and industry as an alternative for high power and medium voltage applications. This paper does the comparison between 19-level symmetrical and proposed asymmetrical MLI. The proposed topology uses unequal DC voltage sources. The proposed inverter topology is investigated for various parameters such as number of switches used and THD which produces maximum output voltage steps. With the help of MATLAB/Simulink environment, the realization of proposed 19 level asymmetric topology is confirmed.

articleTitle: Impact of Doping Density on Junctionless Gate Stack FD-SOI MOSFET for Analog/RF Application
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper examine the impact of Double Doped Layer Gate Stack Junctionless (DDL-GSJL) MOSFET and Highly Doped Source Drain Gate Stack Junctionless (HDSDGSJL) MOSFET. We compare the performance of proposed MOSFET, with uniformly doped conventional junctionless MOSFET. The proposed MOSFET has no pn junction, only ntype non-uniform doping is used. Non-uniform doping is distributed in a horizontal and vertical manner. A high-k material (Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>) is used as gate stack to control the leakage current and increase the I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ON</sub>/I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OFF</sub>. This paper present analog and RF figure of merits (FOM). In the paper major FOMs, output conductance (g<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d</sub>), transconductance (g<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub>), cut-off frequency (f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">T</sub>), transconductance frequency product (TFP) is analyzed. The simulated results reflect that HDSD-GSJL MOSFET exhibit high transconductance, high cut-off frequency and high transconductance frequency product. The structure is designed and analyzed using ATLAS 2D TCAD tools.

articleTitle: Design, Fabrication and characterisation of TE Mode MZI Device for Silicon Photonics Integrated Circuit
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Designing the photonics integrated circuit on silicon platform is a challenging task. For most of the photonic devices interferometers acts as major foundational block. One of the famous interferometer in photonics design is called as Mach Zehender Interferometer(MZI).This paper explains design simulation, fabraction and measurement of fabricated MZI device. The wavelength range has been chosen to be TE polarization 1500-1600 nm with waveguide being strip waveguide. Such five MZI devices have been designed with variation in waveguide length and simulation was performed over larger number of data points. The design have been simulated in software Lumerical mode and Lumerical Interconnect. Based on the simulation the mask layout was prepared for fabrication using tool called KLayout. The complete layout was fabricated over a footprint of 605μm × 410μm at Applied Nanotools Inc. Canada and Washington Nanofabrication Facility USA. The measurement of the fabricated devices have been performed and compared with simulated device.

articleTitle: Microwave Absorption Properties of Building Material Marbel
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Microwave absorption of marbel is extensively studied under X-band frequency (8.2-12.4GHz) electric field at 25°C temperature. Marbel sample is designed and simulated using Ansoft HFSS 13.0 software. The result simultaneously shows the absorption profile in terms of reflectivity profile (S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub>) and transmission profile (S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</sub>) as well as the comparative study on microwave absorption ability for different thickness of various marbel samples. Extensive investigation is conducted to highlight marbel as eco-friendly microwave absorbing material.

articleTitle: Impact of Variable MTU Size of Voice Packet To Reduce Packet Loss In Bandwidth Constraint Military Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Command and control systems in tactical battlefield rely heavily on high quality voice communications. Voice traffic in the battlefield is carried by Military Tactical Networks, which are primarily based on radio links. Most of these radio links have high Bit Error Rate (BER) due to extended ranges, low link margin and enemy jamming action. The bit errors introduced due to any/ combination of these factors results in high packet loss severely impacting voice quality. Packing multiple voice packets in large Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU) Ethernet frames has high-transmission efficiency but large frames have higher probability of getting corrupted in BER conditions. Under such situations, reducing MTU frame has a positive impact on voice call quality. By reducing the MTU size the impact of frame corruption is decreased statically which preserves the voice quality. In this paper, we propose a novel network probe algorithm that selects optimum MTU size for layer 2 Ethernet frames carrying VoIP (Voice over IP) traffic. The probe samples all the network interfaces connected to a node for optimal MTU size. The extensive simulation carried out over a well known platform OMNeT++, reveals that optimum MTU size gave less packet loss and delay in Military Network topology.

articleTitle: Power Factor Improvement of Nonlinear Load Using Boost Converter with Average Current Control
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Now a days, development of industrial application is increases and electrical energy is always in great demand. To meet the demand, we have to improve the quality of power i.e. to improve the power factor of electrical load. Generally, nonlinear load is reason of poor power factor and that affects on conductor losses, voltage regulation, cost and rating of machine. Nonlinear loads are the main source of harmonics which increases Total Harmonic Distortion(THD) in distribution system and results in poor power factor. Conventionally, in full bridge diode rectifier, large value capacitors are used to get more pure DC output. But the use of large value Capacitor introduces current harmonics in supply side. In this type of nonlinear loads, boost converter with average current control strategy is useful. In this paper, simulation results of boost converter with average current control strategy, to reduce harmonics in non-linear load, are presented. The full bridge rectifier with large value capacitor is considered as non-linear load. Results shows that use of boost converter with average current control strategy improves supply side power factor considerably. Also, supply side harmonics are reduced.

articleTitle: Predicting Financial Distress in Enterprises by Applying Multilevel Ensemble Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The exponential growth in technology and economy over the years has delivered data driven statistical learning and Data mining progressively. It has been broadly identified that the determinant factor of financial distress in enterprises is poor management, and company's performance reliably reflects the corporate management. The best an enterprise can deliver is to predict its financial status to survive any future financial crisis. During the study it has been identified that management, investing and financing are three most important sections of a company to predict the financial crisis. In this research paper, a multilevel ensemble model has been proposed to predict the financial distress in various companies. This multi level ensemble approach incorporates six different machine learning models: SVM, ANN, DT, RF, RRF, and LR are combined to predict financial distress.

articleTitle: Survey on Automatic Script Identification Techniques
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Script identification is an essential task especially in India because of existence of 13 different scripts for writing 22 languages. Major applications of script identification are document sorting, automatic translation, selecting of OCR (Optical Character Recognition) and text area identification. Traditionally, researchers have used feature based methods for script identification but it can be automated through deep learning techniques to reduce comprehensive time. Moreover, CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) based deep learning approaches are less explored for script identification problem. Intention behind this survey on script identification is to make researchers more perceived about the usefulness of deep learning techniques and more specifically, the significance of CNN to deal with script identification problem. This paper contains a useful survey on both feature-based and deep learning based domains on popular foreign and Indian scripts. We have shown comparative analysis between both domains which clearly concludes that deep learning methods could be more useful as compared to feature based methods. In addition, limitations and usefulness of CNN based best practices are also presented.

articleTitle: DMARCBox – Corporate Email Security and Analytics using DMARC
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Organizations often face an issue regarding the domain security. Attackers target the domain itself in order to gain higher access for advanced attacks especially email phishing. Innocent users frequently fall prey for this trap and end up giving the credentials to the attackers. There have been many security measures developed for preventing email spoofing, thereby preventing email misuse. Few mentioned notable security policies are STARTTLS, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC. Since DMARC is built upon SPF and DKIM, it results in better security than the others.Key persons of the organizations are responsible for impeding such misuse but the immense workload may hamper this and an important security breach might get overlooked. These key persons require one stop analytical reports to take actions against such abuse. DMARCBox provides an on-site or cloud-based domain security and also provides drill down analytical reports. With a high readability of RUA and RUF emails, DMARCBox provides accurate graphical reports along with mapping the geolocation from where emails are being sent.Having implemented in many organizations, DMARCBox provides an efficient security consequently preventing email spoofing. Testimonials from the key persons state that champions of DMARCBox include: high readability of RUA and RUF emails, better analytical reports that enables to act against misuse, and on-premise solution that obstructs data leak than the cloud-based approach.

articleTitle: A Knowledge Graph Based Approach for Automatic Speech and Essay Summarization
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Every day, big amounts of unstructured data is generated. This data is of the form of essays, research papers, speeches, patents, scholastic articles, book chapters etc. In today's world, it is very important to extract key patterns from huge text passages or verbal speeches. This paper proposes a novel method for summarizing multilingual vocal as well as written paragraphs and speeches, using semantic Knowledge Graphs. Using the proposed model, big text extracts or speeches can be summarized for better understanding and analysis. The method uses speech recognition as well as Named Entity Recognition to identify entities from spoken content to create optimized Knowledge Graphs in the English Language.

articleTitle: Performing SLAM using Low-Cost Sensors for Autonomous Navigation in household environments
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this work, we present a way of performing Simultaneous Localization And Mapping on a mobile robot using an array of ultrasonic sensors as a low cost alternative to laser rangefinders(LIDAR) and RGB-D Cameras. The mobile robot captures information around it using ultrasonic sensor ring, and creates a map with position data obtained from the encoders of motors. The robot runs using ROS on a Intel NUC. The algorithm has been evaluated and tested for household environments and good mapping estimations were obtained.

articleTitle: A Score Level Fusion Scheme for Iris Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The main aim of this paper is to analyse the iris texture which becomes the basis of feature extraction. In Iris Recognition System (IRS), feature extraction is one of the significant steps which is followed by a matching process. The proposed method takes into account three techniques: DSIFT, HOG and DCT. These techniques are individually employed on the blocks that correspond to the regions of interest, not occluded by noise. A block-wise matching of obtained feature vectors is carried out using a standard measure. The true match of the system relies on the three aforementioned techniques which make the system more robust. The experimental results are reported on CASIA-IrisV1 database. The obtained outcomes indicate that the performance of the system increased significantly due to the score level fusion of the matching that makes it suitable for the iris recognition related applications.

articleTitle: Hilbert Huang Transform Based Protection Technique for DSTATCOM Compensated Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This work proposes an Hilbert Huang transform based protection technique for DSTATCOM compensated three phase transmission line. The proposed technique employs three steps. The first step makes the inequity between faults and healthy conditions. The second step identifies the fault section. If a fault is detected in its section then the third stage is triggered which classifies the faulty phase. Hilbert Huang transform has been used to capture the fault information contained in the three phase fault current signals. The three phase current signals recorded at only one end of the line are given to Hilbert Huang transform, which aspires at fault detection, fault section identification and faulty phase classification. The simulation results demonstrate that all types of faults, its section and faulty phase can be perfectly identified. The proposed technique is adaptive to the variation of fault type, fault inception time, fault location, fault resistance, ground resistance and voltage source parameters.

articleTitle: 2x2 Wideband Array MIMO Antenna for 5G Spectral Band
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In this paper, a wideband 2x2 array MIMO antenna is proposed to cover 5G frequency band. The presented antenna is operational under 2:1 VSWR with -10 dB return loss bandwidth for 21.06 GHz - 29.7 GHz frequency range. The proposed antenna has bandwidth of 8.63 GHz. The isolation between the two ports in the entire band is more than 10.52 dB. With the compact design structure of 15.2 x 7.3 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, the proposed antenna offers a gain of more than 3.0 dBi. in the entire band with ECC of less than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> in the whole operating band.

articleTitle: Delay Efficient Generalized Rational Sampling Rate Conversion Polyphase FIR Filter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In practical applications, where chip area and power consumption are the prime concerns, the hardware implementation with the lower computational complexity of a structure is one of the major issues. Time multiplexing and bit serial processing are useful methods to reduce the hardware requirement. However, the delay elements cannot be reduced by using this method so that significant chip area is occupied. Therefore, in this paper, we developed a delay efficient extended version of the generalized rational sampling rate conversion polyphase FIR filter without any adverse effect on Multiplier/Adder complexity. We also calculated the required number of delay elements ( ) which are involved in the presented structure. We foundDa significant reduction in delay elements in comparison to the generalized rational sampling rate conversion polyphase FIR filter. In addition, we show that, if β > (M - 1)(L- 2) , our presented approach always used lesser delay elements compared with an existing similar approach.

Author Keywords: generalized rational sampling rate conversion polyphase FIR filter (GRSRC).

articleTitle: An Algorithm for Microgrid Protection using Z-Bus matrix formulation in a Central Master Controller
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: One of the main challenges faced in the operation of microgrid is the protection coordination due to the presence of different types of distributed energy sources. This paper addresses the issues such as delayed operation of protective relay in the absence of main grid which in turn will affect the relay coordination in microgrid. Majority of the problems can be solved with the help of Master controller (MC) having communication facility with various relays installed in the system. The work carried out proposes an algorithm to find out various relay setting parameters such as Time Multiplier Setting (TMS), Pick up current I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pickup</inf> and the suitable operating characteristics curve for the over current relay during both islanded mode and grid connected mode based on formulation of Z-Bus matrix. The computer program to find out the elements of Z-Bus matrix is also explained with the help of relevant formulae. The relay coordination for both radial and ring type configuration of the microgrid has been studied and results are presented.

articleTitle: Virtual Memory Management of Private Cloud using OpenStack API
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: There is a constantly increasing demand for computing resources in the modern age. The traditional information technology systems cost too high in investment, updating and maintenance to the organizations. Moreover, they fail to perform well with respect to high utilization of resources. The modern paradigm of Cloud Computing answers these issues well. The cloud infrastructures and platforms are not only cost effective but also efficient in handling huge resources. More and more companies are moving to cloud platforms to run their applications. Many software platforms are available for cloud computing under open source software and are free of Apache CloudStack and OpenStack. The current study uses OpenStack cloud and in particular, emphases on the memory management of the cloud for handling virtual machine instances and their distribution.

articleTitle: Analyzing Two Stage CMOS LNA for Wireless Interconnect
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Sooner or later the conventional interconnects used nowadays in high speed performance computing systems are going to put serious performance constraints. As the proportion of CMOS technology scaling and interconnect length scaling differs largely, the interconnect length poses drastic speed limitations on the systems. Hence as technology node scales from 14nm to 7nm shows high improvement on speed on paper but is barely achieved in reality compared to node scaling from 130nm to 90nm. As the speed of operation for HPC systems is in Gb/sec, the power consumption due to conventional interconnect will be higher. The solution to this problem is to use wireless interconnects. The wireless interconnect may be fabricated with on chip wireless transceiver. The on chip antenna and router based architecture may help in reducing those routing delays and also saving chip area. The first block in wireless receiver of wireless interconnect is Low Noise Amplifier (LNA), and this work focuses to design and analyse a CMOS LNA operating at 60 GHz, As most of the HPC systems operate at about 60 GHz. The designed LNA's are compared on the basis of figure of merits.

articleTitle: A Color Image Watermarking Scheme Employing the Features of Directive Contrast in the DWT-SVD Domain
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: With the massive expansion of image security for day to day purposes, image watermarking has become a critical factor regarding protection schemes. Here, we proposed a watermarking plan where we created a secondary image using directive contrast of the DWT (Discrete Wavelet Transform) subbands from the host image and used this secondary image for watermark embedding using DWT-SVD transformation. The horizontal subband was decomposed up to 2-levels during insertion of the watermark into the cover image to achieve better performance against noise attacks. The obtained results depict that our scheme can resist a number of signal processing attacks maintaining good perceptual quality with PSNR above 50 dB and NC more than 0.99. The evaluations of our process justify both of the imperceptibility to human visual system and robustness against noise attacks which are the prime aspects of image watermarking.

articleTitle: Energy Disaggregation for NILM applications using Shallow and Deep Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Comparative study is conducted by applying deep and shallow network on energy data for non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM) applications. From the total energy consumption, various appliance consumption can be disaggregated using shallow and deep networks. The study highlights the effective method for energy disaggregation from the total energy consumption using algorithms rather than the expensive method of separately metering individual loads. Shallow algorithm support vector regression and deep learning algorithms such as deep neural network (DNN) and long short term memory (LSTM) are used in this study and their performance is evaluated.

Author Keywords: Energy disaggregation; shallow network: Support Vector Regression

articleTitle: Development of Embedded System for Monitoring of Life Test Setup of LED Lamp
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Indian standard (IS 16102-2: 2017), specifies the life test and performance test methods and conditions, to categorize the self-ballasted LED lamps. This test process is being done with manual intervention with camera observation and digital timer. This paper proposes, the digital automation of entire life test setup process using embedded system. The entire test process is monitored and results are displayed in LCD. This gives accurate run time and life of LED lamp during the test. The information of lamp failure and completion of test is sent through mail to concerned person.

articleTitle: Investigation of Effect of Noise Parameter on Brain MR Image Restoration
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The effect of noise parameter, standard deviation, on Brain MR Image restoration was investigated in order to select the filtering mechanism to get exact restoration. It is a well known fact that the noise in Brain MR image is Rician distributed, but if the standard deviation is between 4.51 to 4.28, the noise is neither Rician nor Gaussian; however when standard deviation is below 4.28 the noise behaves as Gaussian distributed. For accurate restoration, knowledge of this threshold value of σ, where noise characteristics changes, is essential so that corresponding filter can be chosen to remove the noise present in the image. It was found that the characteristics of noise distribution are differentiated on the basis of filtering competency of linear and non-linear filters. Gaussian filter is efficient at low standard deviation, σ <; 4.28 whereas standard deviation σ ≥4.28 Hybrid filter works well; this is verified using Structural Similarity Index measurement (SSIM),Mean Square Error (MSE) and Peak Signal to Noise Ration (PSNR). Hybrid filter is nothing but a series combination of Gaussian and median filter. The performance of Hybrid filter was also compared with Homomorphic filter, which works best for Rician distributed images, and thus verified that Hybrid filter works best for all three types of distribution over given range of standard deviation.. The proposed algorithm was implemented on synthetic images from BrainWeb data base using MATLAB 2015a.

articleTitle: Prototype of Smart Trainable Robotic Arm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The robotic arm is a kind of manipulator, used to carry out most difficult tasks, which is the need of today's world and its applications are in vast fields. It can be used for many purposes such as to pick and drop and to work in the environment where a human cannot work i.e. harmful chemicals, high temperature and so on. One needs some skilled personnel to make that robotic arm functional as per requirement and for making some amendments in its functionality, one has to reprogram its parameters which needs an expert. A robotic arm that can learn from its mimicry done by a human which can be easily taught to perform certain operation as per its application by an unskilled person. We have designed a prototype of the robotic arm which can work according to the way one teaches furthermore, robotic arm does not need a skilled person, the mimicry feedback will be recorded in a processing unit i.e. microcontroller (Arduino) and on a single command of play that robotic arm will work continuously to perform that specific task.

articleTitle: Fuzzy based active stiffness control of a synergistically compliant variable stiffness shape memory actuator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Shape Memory Alloy (SMA) based actuator has proven to be very convenient in variable stiffness and active compliance applications viz. robotics and bio-medical devices. The unique attractive feature of SMA is its stiffness varying property during phase transformation, in addition to its high force to weight ratio, mechanical simplicity and flexibility; all desirable for the design of new actuation technologies. Stiffness variation in the SMA based actuator using direct stiffness feedback for scaled down applications is comparatively loftier than in the conservatively designed variable stiffness actuator. The stiffness control performance of a newly developed synergistically operated translational compliant variable stiffness actuator (STCVSA) is determined and presented in this paper, for which system identification technique is employed to achieve the actuator model. Adaptive control algorithms (fuzzy PID and fuzzy Sliding Mode Control (SMC)) are considered for implementing the stiffness feedback control. The simulation results of fuzzy SMC and fuzzy PID controller is shown and is concluded that Fuzzy SMC has a robust nature capable to model uncertainties, disturbances and parameter variations.

articleTitle: Intelligent Transport System based Fall-Back Mechanism - An alternative for safety approach in VANET
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Vehicular Ad-Hoc Network (VANET) is the utmost growing research area in wireless communication. Advancing the research in VANET will bring crucial upgradation in wireless technology. Some of the major challenges include network reliability, security and safety. This paper pays attention on current technologies related to Intelligent Transport System (ITS) and sensor based VANET used in exchange of data in vehicular environment. In addition a proposed mechanism is derived as an alternative approach for providing safety and an uninterruptable vehicular traffic flow which act independently not relying on network connectivity with Road Side Units (RSU), which compliance of hardware in On Board Unit (OBU).

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Contrast Enhancement Techniques in Computed Tomography of Lung Images
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Death rates due to cancer are elevating day by day. Millions of people across the world are affected due to this deadly disease. US population suffers from lung cancer at a higher rate in recent years. Computed tomography is a reliable diagnostic methods for lung cancer. In this method the radiologist face challenges to accurately identify the malignant lung nodules. Due to a large number of cases often radiologists missed the malignant nodules in images. Recently, many research works carried out in the areas of automated lung nodule detection have shown remarkable improvement in the radiologist performance. It is necessary to take into consideration the quality of images in the detection of pulmonary nodules. This has inspired us to analyze the preprocessing stage that comprises of a contrast enhancement stage of lung images. In this regard, the performance of different contrast enhancement methods is compared for lung image available in the public LIDC database using standard contrast evaluation metrics.

articleTitle: Remote Controlled Rescue Robot Using ZigBee Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Rescue robots, which are robots that have been designed for the purpose of rescuing people, are useful in natural and man-made disasters. In this paper, we develop a remote controlled rescue robot using ZigBee communication. The main body of the rescue robot is a caterpillar with two arm crawlers. Two arm crawlers are used for running over obstacles. Users can control the rescue robot forward/backward and right/left with a remote controller through ZigBee communication. Also it is possible to observe the situation of a disaster area by a Wi-Fi camera on PC. The Wi-Fi camera is rotated right/left with the remote controller. The effective distance between the rescue robot and the remote controller is 120 m outdoors.

articleTitle: Control of DC-DC CUK Converter by Fractional Order PIλDμ Controller
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper has been explored with the control of DC-DC CUK Converter by Fractional Order PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</sup>D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup> Controller. Non-integer order dynamic model based on fractional calculus or, differentiation or integration is very valuable to the new generation of industry. Fractional Order PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</sup>D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup> Controller holds additional degree of freedom which provides better time and frequency response compared to classical PID Controller. Fractional Order PID Controller parameters have been optimized using a Soft Computing Technique i.e. Bacterial Foraging Optimization Technique (BFO). A non linear function has been minimized to get the optimal parameters of Fractional Order PID Controller. The non linear function is proposed with integral square error, settling-time, rise time and maximum overshoot. In presence of variation in load, reference voltage, input voltages and to obtain fast recovery in output voltage response a control scheme is derived, through MATLAB simulation.

articleTitle: Advanced Spying and Hazardous Object Pick Up and Disposal Robotic Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The following prototype is developed addressing the problems where there is high risk for humans to operate crucial tasks and being unable to move in the uneven surfaces. The vehicle is designed with such congeniality that it can move in the rough ambient. It can fetch aimed object and dislocate accordingly from distance. It is also embedded with live video surveillance and GPS tracking module which adds benefit to locate and identify in the area where there is no possibilities of human access, added with various sensors it makes the vehicle more relevant to perform risky task and those data are continuously being notified.

articleTitle: A study on Blockchain enabled Applications and its Security Issues
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Blockchain technology was first established because of its use in cryptocurrencies, but its applications are not limited just to this field. We have explored other fields like Finance, Auditing, Digital identity, Digital Voting and Healthcare where blockchain can be used to increase efficiency, and how it fares compared to the traditional systems. The paper compares the traditional and blockchain enabled systems based on parameters like privacy, data and application security, consensus algorithms and mining computations. However, like any other technology, this one too might have flaws which can be exploited. This paper also lists the security challenges that need to be kept in mind while implementing these systems.

articleTitle: Time Domain Energy Detector approach for Detection of Moving Ground Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper introduces a time domain energy detector (ED) approach for vehicle detection using a single microphone. The detection of a deterministic, as well as the stochastic signal in the presence of white Gaussian noise (WGN), is a very challenging task. The ground vehicle generates a similar kind of signal with unknown information. Therefore, there is need of robust vehicle detection algorithm which must detect a vehicle with low false alarm. We proposed an algorithm based on energy detector and estimation of threshold value depending on noise's variance for moving vehicle detection using acoustics data. The energy distribution of the signal follows the chi-square distribution. These decision statistics reveal the vehicle presence information from the signal and detection probability of a true event. The algorithm is tested on the experimental data acquired from the field trials of the moving vehicle. The receiver operating characteristics are computed through Monte Carlo simulations for validation of the proposed algorithm. The results show that the algorithm is capable to detect the moving vehicle with low false alarm even at low signal to noise ratio.

articleTitle: Design of a Low Power PLL in 90nm CMOS Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: A PLL is a key element in clock generation and wireless transceivers. This paper presents the design of fast locking PLL. The PLL is designed in Virtuoso tool by Cadence in Analog Design Environment using GPDK 90nm CMOS technology with operating frequency of 1GHz and lock time of 100ns. A current starved VCO is exploited to bring down power consumed and achieve high frequency. Various simulations were performed using Spectre simulator. The PLL consumes total power of 4.2mW at supply voltage of 1.8V.

articleTitle: Scalable Growth of High-Quality MoS2 Film by Magnetron Sputtering: Application for NO2 Gas Sensing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: To address the formidable challenges associated with large-scale and high-quality fabrication of MoS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, we reported a two-step process for growing large-scalable MoS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> films with superb quality. Firstly, we grow different thickness Mo films on SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/Si substrates by DC magnetron sputtering technique. Secondly, the deposited film was then sulfurized in a sulfur-rich environment. The qualitative analysis confirmed the growth of highly crystalline and continuous few-layer to multi-layer MoS2 films. We have also examined the sensing performance of deposited ML-MoS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> film upon NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> exposure.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Proportional Integral Derivative Controller and it’s hybrids
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Proportional Integral Derivative (PID) controller has been used in feedback mechanism since time immemorial. This work discusses about another hybrid of PID controller of the form PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x+i</sup>yD<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">a+ib</sup> also termed as Complex Fractional order PID controller. This variant of PID controller has excess of tuning parameters, more than any of the PID and its other fractional order variant (also known as Fractional order PID controller). Henceforth, this research realizes CFOPID controller and synthesizes all the variants of PID controller's parameter utilizing Genetic Algorithm (starting from primitive Proportional controller to advanced CFOPID controller) by minimizing the weighted sum of error specifications. It additionally relates the responses of each of the controllers and concludes the superior variant of PID controller.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm for Optimal Feature Vector Selection in Facial Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Facial Recognition has a large number of real world applications in Security, Marketing, Healthcare, etc. In order for these applications to be feasible with respect to real time applications it's important that the feature vectors from these facial images be represented such that it is computationally efficient without compromising accuracy. Principal component analysis has often been used for dimensionality reduction. However using an evolutionary algorithm like genetic algorithm can ensure that only the best features are selected to increase efficiency and accuracy while ensuring overfitting doesn't take place.This paper demonstrates a way to effectively represent vectors of a face image using genetic algorithm and its comparison against other similar forms of representation.

articleTitle: Force Myography based Continuous Estimation of Knee Joint Angle using Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Recent development in lower limb intelligent prosthetics has led to building an interface for active training in rehabilitation. In this paper, a force myography (FMG) based method has been used to model and estimate the knee joint angle during walking at four different self-selected speeds i.e. slow, normal, fast and run. An eight-channel in-house FMG data acquisition was developed to collect the data wirelessly. A trained artificial neural network (ANN) was fed with FMG data to estimate the knee joint angle. Till now, the experiment was performed for one subject. Root mean square error (RMSE) and the cross-correlation coefficient were used to quantify the accuracy of the proposed method. The results hold promise for FMG based affordable robotic rehabilitation in the future.

articleTitle: Development of Faculty Profiling and Capability Enhancement Advisor System using Intelligent Predictive String Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Faculty personnel nowadays are faced with a change of roles and responsibilities. As a result, they must involve themselves in the current trend of professional growth. Faculty development enables personal and professional growth so there is a great need for faculty development plans. The authors of this study developed a Faculty Profiling and Capability Enhancement Advisor System that can generate a faculty development plan according to the profiles and qualifications of the faculty members based on their individual Personal Data Sheets. The system can also recommend further trainings for faculty members based on their specializations. These outputs are accurately generated by the system through utilizing the Intelligent Predictive String Search Algorithm (IPSSA). The developmental and descriptive methods of research were adopted in the study, both in the development and evaluation of the system. The evaluation form included the following criteria, based on ISO 9126 standards: Functionality, Reliability, Efficiency, Maintainability, and Portability. The overall evaluation of the system was "Acceptable", based on the combined inputs of the respondents comprised of faculty members, school administrators, and ICT experts. Improvements to the code and security of the system through implementation of Secure Socket Layer (SSL) encryption are recommended. Another enhancement that can be added is a function that provides the system flexibility in updating forms as they are amended.

articleTitle: Modelling Coconut Fiber Coir and Charcoal Powder Made Microwave Absorber over X-band Frequency
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Microwave return loss profile of coconut fiber coir and charcoal composites made microwave absorber is studied under X-band frequency. Coconut fiber coir is an eco-friendly agricultural residue. In this work, absorption rate in terms of return loss profile of the coconut fiber coir and charcoal composite based microwave absorber is discussed for three different thickness (2mm, 4mm, and 8mm). The microwave absorber is simulated in CST microwave studio suite 2018 using the reported value of permittivity, permeability and conductivity.

articleTitle: Conversion of Electricity from Waste Heat of Flue Gases
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Day by day as the requirement of the electricity increases, it is necessary for the development of the country to fulfill the demand of the electricity for the human. After 2-3 decades, it may have the termination of conventional energy sources such as coal, petrol, diesel. To fulfill this maximum demand, either the proper utilization of the energy sources is done or increase the energy efficiency of the present generation capacity. In this paper we are going to implement the technology according to law of conservation of energy. It states that "energy neither be created, nor be destroyed but simply it will transfer from one form to another form".According to the law of conservation of energy, we are going to convert the heat energy from the flue gases to the electricity by using thermoelectric converter (TEC) or thermocouple. In various industries, the heat energy is wasted in the various sections. With the consideration of that heat energy, we have to be aware for the implementation of TEC or thermocouple in the exhaust system. In India coal which is found having a low calorific value. Thus the efficiency of Thermal Power System (TPS) decreases. To increase efficiency, we have to utilize the waste heat of the exhaust system in the chimney.Another main aspect is to generate the electricity by the green energy production and utilization of wastage energy. It encourages the cogeneration and reduction of the production cost of energy. It also increasing the life of the conventional energy sources and save them for the future utilization at the time of energy crisis. It is also related to the energy conservation and reduces the maximum demand of the energy with proper energy management.

articleTitle: A Texture based Image Retrieval for Different Stages of Alzheimer’s Disease
